prose: Joining InnerVerse for their first time, Tamara Sheville and Brandon Thomas explore one of the most absurd deceptions in the history of psyops.

Drawing from her background in hazardous materials and chemical, biological and radiation hazard response work, Tamara is primed to deliver a truth bomb about the science of nuclear fission, why it works for power plants but will never go boom, and how the evidence from Japan's supposedly nuked cities tells a different story.
As co-host of the Mysterious Universe podcast, Brandon Thomas brings his jovial yet razor sharp spiritual discernment to bear on the devilish details of this conspiracy.
ext: Mechanics of nuclear fission and why it can’t explode
Underwater tests, mushroom clouds, and what creates those visuals
